Name: A live body shuffle stops at its duration
Subsystem: The animation scheduler's live keyframe path and the tick loop that serves its deadline
Purpose: Idle streams a body keyframe with a duration and nothing else drives the scheduler. Before the correction nothing called Advance in that state, so the stop never went out and the wheels ran until something else countermanded them. Offline the stop is asserted against the message log; on the robot the wheels either stop or they do not.
ExpectedTelemetry: the reported wheel speeds go non-zero and return to zero within a frame or two of the duration
ExpectedPhysical: He shuffles forward for about a second and stops by himself. He does not keep creeping.
BlockedReason: MOV (Head, lift and a short drive) is blocked, and CR1 depends on it
